definitions.explanation: Humble form of 見る, used when the speaker views something belonging to or offered by a superior.

examples.japanese: お{写真|しゃしん}を{拝見|はいけん}しました。
{資料|しりょう}を{拝見|はいけん}してもよろしいですか。
examples.english: May I take a look at the documents? (humble)

notes:
{拝見|はいけん}する is the humble form of {見|み}る.

POLITENESS:
- {見|み}る: neutral
- {拝見|はいけん}する: humble (lowers speaker)
- ご{覧|らん}になる: honorific (elevates other)

USAGE:
Used in formal/business situations when viewing something belonging to someone of higher status.
